_comment: EXAMPLE DATA - hypothetical target and findings for demonstrating the report format. Not a real assessment.
methods: Ordinary GET requests to public pages

findings.title: Publicly downloadable database backup
findings.description: A SQL dump is directly downloadable from the web root.
findings.impact: Full customer data, including password hashes, can be downloaded by anyone.
remediation: Remove the file and block /backup/ at the web server.
Rotate all credentials in the dump and assess breach-notification duties.

findings.title: TLS certificate expired
findings.description: The served certificate expired 9 days ago.
findings.evidence:
notAfter=2026-10-03 PT
Issuer: Let's Encrypt R11
findings.impact: Browsers show a full-page warning; users are trained to click through.
remediation: Renew the certificate and fix auto-renewal.

findings.title: Session cookie missing Secure and HttpOnly
findings.description: The session cookie lacks Secure and HttpOnly flags. The value below is long and must wrap without overflowing the card.
findings.impact: Cookies may be sent over plain HTTP and read by injected script.
remediation: Set Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

findings.title: No HSTS header
findings.impact: First visits are open to SSL stripping.

findings.title: nginx 1.18.0 may be affected by CVE-2021-23017 (resolver off-by-one)
findings.description: The Server header reports nginx/1.18.0, a version listed as affected by CVE-2021-23017. Distribution backports are common, so the version string alone does not prove the host is vulnerable.
findings.evidence:
Server: nginx/1.18.0 (Ubuntu)
NVD: CVE-2021-23017, CVSS 7.7 (High), affects nginx 0.6.18–1.20.0
findings.impact: If the resolver directive is in use and the package is unpatched, a crafted DNS response could crash a worker or worse.
remediation: Confirm the installed package version with the host owner (apt policy nginx).

findings.title: Server version disclosed
findings.description: The Server header discloses an exact version.

findings.title: Hosting provider
findings.description: Hosted on a single VPS without a CDN.

unverified.reason: Authenticated testing is out of scope for a passive check.
